message:
As Enclosure and Structural Designer, the whole filled box stands on soft farm soil on six pads without sinking, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer.

In plain words one small car of weight spreads to about four person-weights per foot so soft ground still carries it. The panel listing in Insulated PUR PIR Sandwich Panel 100mm Cold Room Panels Roof Cladding from China Factory (E60) lists 100 mm weight 12.1 kg per square metre, consistent with the 14.0 kg per square metre row in Fire Proof Interior / Exterior PU/ Rock Wool Insulation Wall / Ceiling Sandwich Panel for Cold Room (E61), supporting the summed chamber mass budget (E66) of 1780 kg for produce plus crates plus Polyisocyanurate (PIR, rigid foam insulation) panels plus battery plus plates, about one small car in everyday scale, giving 18.2 kPa per pad in the pad pressure check (E68) on six 400 mm pads, well below the 150 kPa net allowable soil pressure used in Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), with adjustable feet and raised plinth as shown in the split layout sketch (E70).

The full sun array does not fit over the cold roof so the shade frame must split, Solar Energy Systems Engineer. In plain words six modules cover a parking space while the cold roof is a small bedroom floor. The module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) lists dimensions 1722 by 1134 by 30 mm and weight 20.5 kg, matched by dimensions 1762 by 1134 by 30 mm and weight 21.5 kg in SolarPeak Pro 400 (E65), giving six-module footprint 11.7 square metres in the panel footprint calc (E69), about a parking space, against a 2.4 m by 1.8 m roof of 4.32 square metres, so the split shade with 2 Photovoltaic (PV, solar-electric panel) modules on the roof gantry plus 4 modules on a separate ground frame on own footings in that same split layout sketch (E70) carries no panel loads into sandwich panels and keeps the vent gap that holds the 203 watt conduction in Professional Manufacturer Factory Keep Warm Insulated PU Sandwich Panel (E32).

I take up the infiltration method in Designing Efficient Cold Storage: Key Factors and Cooling Loads (E51) that Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer used, Manager. In plain words his air-changes leak maths confirms my curtain and seal choice. That method plus his 0.44 kilowatt-hour per day door estimate means a single hinged insulated door with Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC, flexible plastic) strip curtain plus freestanding racking with sealed rear penetration and outside drain carries no point loads through foam and stays hose-cleanable, and I am not ready because the grown array footings and 43 degree pull-down seal test must still be agreed.
